youtube_title: Friend Stuck to a Live Wire: Pull Him Off or Switch Off the Power? Brave vs Normal #18 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL, WHO'S RIGHT? #18. A friend fixing an iron at home gets an electric shock and is stuck to the wire. Brave grabs him with bare hands. Normal switches off the main power, then pushes the wire away with a dry wooden stick. Comment B or N.
Answer: NORMAL. While the current is still flowing, touching the person makes you part of the circuit and you get a shock too. Cut the power first at the main switch or unplug. If you can't, stand on something dry and push the wire away with dry wood. Then call 112 and give first aid.
Source: St John Ambulance electric shock first aid. General awareness, not medical advice.
